feature_time: first recorded release state; only strictly earlier releases in same round
threshold_selection: Training OOF only: balanced accuracy; positive-only selective threshold targets empirical precision >=0.8 with >=500 examples. No guaranteed precision.

severity.blinded_players_unit: distinct enemies with positive added flash; retrospective registered count
severity.conditional_count_postprocessing: Clip positive conditional mean to [1,5], the five-opponent support; unconditional expectation remains probability times conditional mean

deployment.status: refitted on all known outcomes after selection; held-out scores use the separate evaluation model

limitations: Internal holdout was already inspected in earlier iterations; no new external evaluation
Unknown outcomes are not imputed; predictions concern the registered-outcome population
No enemy positions, round winners or causal grenade contribution in source
Past releases are observer information and may be unavailable to a live player
Initial projectile velocity and throw strength are not established by this source

setup_evaluation.interpretation: Frozen setup model and severity parameters; deployment refitted on all known outcomes

validation_storage: One table: selected OOF/held-out heads, candidate OOF, setup comparison and matched-capacity ablation. Null candidate test columns are intentional.
